extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: mail delivery truck (right-hand drive), approx. 5.0 x 2.3 x 2.5 m (L x W x H incl. mirror arms), wheel diameter 0.72 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow body with transparent windows, right-hand drive seat and steering wheel, sorting shelf with letter trays and parcels inside; no post horn, no logo, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
